com.invoiceparserpro/capability.description: Undo a duplicate dismissal between the selected invoices. Changes their grouping; saved validation warnings and accounting holds remain. Review and confirm the exact change first. The preview expires after five minutes.
examples: Preview restoring duplicate relationships between the invoices we selected. Show the affected records and remaining validation warnings, then wait for my confirmation.

description: Apply only the exact change returned by preview_restore_duplicate_relationships, after the user confirms that preview. Accepts its confirmation_token only; changed or expired records require a new preview. Prepare restoring duplicate relationships between the selected invoices. Requires confirmation; does not delete or change invoice amounts.

confirmation_token.description: The exact token returned by this operation’s preview, after the user confirms its displayed changes.
confirmation_token.title: Confirmation Token

name: restore_duplicate_relationships
title: Undo a duplicate dismissal
